title: JITSO_PROJECT names the project: a dry run from a cwd outside git succeeds, and a JITSO_PROJECT that is not a git checkout exits 3 naming the folder
source: intended: docs/architecture.md section 6 (project root, the dispatcher handoff): JITSO_PROJECT is read first, validated as a git checkout
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-7, dispatcher project handoff; docs/architecture.md section 6). The dispatched claude runs from a folder outside git, so the project reaches `jitso launch` through the environment variable JITSO_PROJECT. When it is set, every command uses the primary checkout of that folder and ignores the cwd. Step 1: with JITSO_PROJECT={{PROJECT}} and the cwd {{HOME}} (outside git) a dry run exits 0 and prints the card. Step 2: JITSO_PROJECT names a folder that is not a git checkout (an existing folder, with the cwd inside the project, so the variable wins over the cwd): exit 3, nothing on stdout, exactly one stderr line that names the folder and says it is not a git checkout, orca never called. Without JITSO_PROJECT a launch from {{HOME}} stays the N-1 case (project/outside-git/launch).
